items.work: Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
items.performers: Leif Ove Andsnes; Berlin Philharmonic; Mariss Jansons
items.label: Warner Classics
items.note: All three movements of the concerto, paired on the same album with Schumann’s A-minor concerto, which Grieg had heard Clara Schumann play in Leipzig. The first movement runs about thirteen minutes, cadenza included.

links.title: Grieg & Schumann: Piano Concertos on Apple Music

items.work: Peer Gynt — incidental music, Op. 23 (nineteen numbers)
items.performers: San Francisco Symphony and Chorus; Herbert Blomstedt
items.label: Decca
items.note: Nineteen of the twenty-six numbers, many more than the two suites contain, including the Act I prelude, Ingrid’s Lament, the troll king’s hall, Morning Mood, Solveig’s Song and the cradle song that ends the play.

links.title: Grieg: Peer Gynt (Incidental Music) on Apple Music

items.performers: Anne Sofie von Otter; Bengt Forsberg, piano
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: All eight Haugtussa songs on Arne Garborg’s New Norwegian poems, then the six German songs of Op. 48 and songs to Danish and Norwegian words, including En Svane, Med en Vandlilje and Våren.

items.work: Lyric Pieces — a selection from Op. 12 to Op. 71
items.label: EMI Classics (now Warner Classics)
items.note: Twenty-four pieces from nine of the ten books, from the Arietta of Op. 12 to Remembrances in Op. 71, the last book Grieg published.
